record.question: Who was appointed as the National Security Advisor under the NDA Government?
record.explanation: Answer C: Brajesh Mishra. Brajesh Mishra served as National Security Adviser and Principal Secretary to Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee in the NDA administration. The other named advisers served the subsequent UPA administration. Reference: https://www.archivepmo.nic.in/drmanmohansingh/content_print.php?nodeid=1521&nodetype=1. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
